working_features: Pygame window opens and displays a grid-based playing field
Snake appears and can be controlled with arrow keys
Snake moves continuously in the current direction at a steady pace
Food spawns at random unoccupied positions
Snake grows longer when it eats food
Score counter displayed and increments on eating
Game ends on wall collision
Game ends on self-collision
Game over screen displayed with final score
Game can be restarted by pressing a key after game over
